description: This file contains mock implementations and test scaffolding code for HDMI CEC protocol components, including MessageDecoder, Connection, LibCCEC, MessageEncoder, and their associated methods and external dependencies.

classes.name: MessageDecoder
classes.description: Mock implementation of a message decoder for HDMI CEC protocol, with methods to set implementation, decode messages, and manage the singleton instance.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Represents a connection instance with methods to open, close, send, poll, and manage frame listeners, using a singleton pattern.

classes.name: LibCCEC
classes.description: Interface for managing the LibCCEC implementation, with singleton access, initialization, and address management.

classes.name: MessageEncoder
classes.description: Mock implementation for message encoding in HDMI CEC, with methods to set implementation and encode different message types.

methods.name: MessageDecoder::setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation for the MessageDecoder singleton, with a check to ensure 'impl' is either null or being reset.

methods.name: MessageDecoder::decode
methods.description: Decodes an incoming CEC frame using the assigned implementation.

methods.name: Connection::setImpl
methods.description: Sets the current implementation object for the Connection singleton.

methods.name: Connection::open
methods.description: Opens the connection using the underlying implementation.

methods.name: Connection::close
methods.description: Closes the connection using the underlying implementation.

methods.name: Connection::addFrameListener
methods.description: Adds a frame listener to the connection.

methods.name: Connection::ping
methods.description: Pings a target address with error handling.

methods.name: Connection::sendToAsync
methods.description: Sends a frame asynchronously to a target address.

methods.name: Connection::sendTo
methods.description: Sends a frame to a specified address, with optional timeout.

methods.name: Connection::poll
methods.description: Polls the connection for incoming data.

methods.name: LibCCEC::setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation object for LibCCEC singleton.

methods.name: LibCCEC::init
methods.description: Initializes the LibCCEC instance with a name.

methods.name: LibCCEC::init
methods.description: Initializes the LibCCEC instance without parameters.

methods.name: LibCCEC::getPhysicalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the physical address through the implementation.

methods.name: LibCCEC::addLogicalAddress
methods.description: Adds a logical address and returns an identifier.

methods.name: LibCCEC::getLogicalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves a logical address based on device type.

methods.name: MessageEncoder::setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation object for MessageEncoder singleton.
